name: San Millán Yuso and Suso Monasteries
description: In the village of San Millán de la Cogolla in La Rioja, two monasteries stand one above the other. Suso, the small Romanesque "upper" monastery, grew around the hermitage of St Millán and is where scribes jotted the earliest known written Spanish and Basque phrases in a Latin manuscript. Yuso, the grand 16th-century "lower" monastery, still houses a living monastic community.
